title: 免费火鸡不免费：整篮账单藏玄机，火鸡涨10%只是开头？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: One thing I was wondering, Dina, you know, turkeys giving away inexpensive turkeys on Thanksgiving or even free turkeys, like that grocery stores have long had these promotions where you
segments.zh: 我一直在想，迪娜，你知道，感恩节送便宜火鸡甚至免费火鸡，就像超市长期以来一直有这些促销活动，你

segments.en: get a free turkey if you spend a certain amount of money or just these like impossibly cheap turkeys.
segments.zh: 消费一定金额就能获得免费火鸡，或者只是这些便宜得不可思议的火鸡。

segments.en: What are the economics of that? They are taking a loss on those turkeys, I assume.
segments.zh: 这其中的经济账是什么？我猜他们在这些火鸡上是亏本的。

segments.en: Yeah, that's the loss leader where they say like come in will give you either like a totally discounted or free turkey, but then they have you for the rest of the basket. So all the other
segments.zh: 是的，这就是亏本引流，他们说进来吧，我们会给你一只完全打折或免费的火鸡，但然后他们就把你套在其余购物篮上了。所以所有其他

segments.en: things that you're buying for that meal, you're getting at that supermarket. It's worth noting that actually if you're not so lucky to get a free turkey this year, then you're going to be paying
segments.zh: 你为那顿饭买的东西，你都在那家超市买。值得注意的是，实际上如果你今年没那么幸运得到免费火鸡，那么你将支付

segments.en: actually a higher price this year for your turkey than last year, according to the American farm bureau. Yeah, it priced up about 10%. 10%. Yeah. And in terms of other big, you know, increase in price,
segments.zh: 根据美国农场局的数据，今年火鸡的价格实际上比去年更高。是的，它上涨了约10%。10%。是的。就其他大幅涨价而言，

segments.en: like where are consumers kind of getting hit the most? Or where are we going to hit the most?
segments.zh: 消费者在哪里受到最大冲击？或者我们将在哪里受到最大冲击？

segments.en: So we've seen a variety of price changes. Some things are going up and some things are going down. So
segments.zh: 所以我们看到了各种价格变化。有些东西在上涨，有些东西在下降。所以

segments.en: we have from the American farm bureau that the 30 ounce can of pumpkin pie is going, mix is going
segments.zh: 我们从美国农场局得知，30盎司的南瓜派混合料价格将上涨

segments.en: up 1.9%. That's not too bad. A dozen dinners below the rate of inflation. That's almost paying you.
segments.zh: 1.9%。这还不算太糟。一打晚餐低于通胀率。这几乎是在给你钱。
